paragraphs.source_en: Before we begin work on the 7 Habits of Highly Effective People, I would like to suggest two paradigm shifts that will greatly increase the value you will receive from this material.

paragraphs.source_en: First, I would recommend that you not “see” this material as a book, in the sense that it is something to read once and put on a shelf.

paragraphs.source_en: You may choose to read it completely through once for a sense of the whole. But the material is designed to be a companion in the continual process of change and growth.
